name: burrow-flow
description: The interactive backend API index: every route traced route→middleware→handler→store→SQL→table by the flowscan static analyzer, rendered as a clickable wire diagram. Click any hop to jump to the code, arm a symbol-anchored breakpoint on the handler, send a query to the DB explorer. Feeds on the target project's oracle digest when present; works digest-less on any chi-shaped Go backend.

scripts.test: node test/model.test.js && node test/diagram.test.js && node test/httpgen.test.js

burrow.flow.backendDir.description: The Go backend module directory flowscan analyzes. Empty = auto-detect: the first workspace folder containing backend/go.mod uses its backend/ subdirectory.

burrow.flow.oracleApp.description: App name passed to the target project's oracle (`go run ./cmd/oracle --digest <app>`). The oracle is optional — without one, flowscan still discovers every registration.

burrow.flow.flowscanDir.description: Directory of the flowscan tool (contains its go.mod). Empty = the copy shipped in the Burrow repo at tools/flowscan.

burrow.flow.goBin.description: The go binary used to run the oracle and flowscan.

burrow.flow.baseUrl.description: Default {{baseUrl}} seeded into the generated Route Runner file (editable there; your edit survives regeneration).

burrow.flow.seedProfile.description: Path to the target project's seed profile (realistic ids and field values used when generating the Route Runner file). Empty = the convention infra/seed/seed.json under the project root. Relative paths resolve against the project root.
